Ogre
Frightful humanoids, 8–10′ tall, dressed
in animal hides. Often dwell in caves.

AC 5 [14] HD 4+1 (19hp) Att Club (1d10)
THAC0 15 [+4] MV 90′ (30′) SV D10 W11
P12 B13 S14 (4) ML 10 AL Chaotic XP 125
NA 1d6 (2d6) TT C + 1,000gp
▶ Sack: Outside of the lair, carry a sack
containing 1d6 × 100gp.
▶ Hate neanderthals: Attack on sight.
